info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Refunds API provides a streamlined method for retrieving information about tickets eligible for refunds within the event ticketing system. This endpoint allows users to access refund details for purchased tickets, including refund status and associated events. Typical consumers of this API include event organizers, customer support teams, and ticket buyers looking to manage their ticket refunds efficiently. By enabling easy access to refund information, the API enhances user experience and supports operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about ticket refunds, including eligibility, refund amount, and status. It is designed to provide ticket holders with the necessary information to understand the refund process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a refund request for a ticket. Ensure that you provide the necessary details as specified in the schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and refund details are returned.

status.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the refund request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the refund operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the refund operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the refund operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsRefundsRespons.description: Response schema for the GET refund operation indicating the status and details of the refund request.
